entities.summary: Robert E. Donham was an American professional basketball player. Donham was selected in the third round of the 1950 NBA draft by the Boston Celtics after a collegiate career at Ohio State. In four NBA seasons, all with the Celtics, Donham recorded 1,818 points, 1,071 rebounds and 706 assists. After his playing career ended, Donham became the junior varsity basketball coach at the University of Washington, where he was working on his doctorate in physical education. In 1957, he became the head coach at Bowdoin College. He resigned in 1962 to enter the securities business.
